acceptance.description: The optional decision_register contract field is validated and existing v2 contracts without it remain compatible.

Preparation and dispatch are mechanically blocked for every phase named by an unresolved decision; dispatch also requires the current independently reviewed plan. Confirmed or delegated decisions require recorded authority and resolution, with safe error messages.

Shared coordinator, planning, plan-review, engineering-plan template, and operator guidance enforce latest-user-outcome fidelity, decision provenance/holds, credible architecture alternatives before consequential platform-specific work, evidence matched to runtime/OS/security boundaries, and reassessment after non-advancing retries.

Canonical Solopreneur source and focused tests verify the phase gate, legacy compatibility, and prepare-to-dispatch freshness; only the active product is synchronized, clean managed-file drift and source/product template parity are confirmed, and an independent code review confirms there are no external side effects or model-calling hooks.
